caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile piece, resembling an embroidered rug or tapestry, with a decorative border and fringes. The main background color is a light beige or cream. The border is composed of diagonal pink and tan stripes, with a green inner outline framing the central section. The fringe around the outer border is dark green. The central design features a symmetrical arrangement of red and pink flowers with green leaves, centered around a decorative basket or vase that has a brown base and a blue-patterned body, with additional blue and pink details on the flowers within. The flowers and foliage are spread out evenly, creating a balanced composition within the bordered area.
title: Embroidered Rug
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
